id: \rThis place is too cold, you know?
en: \rThis place is too cold, you know?
it: \rQuesto posto è troppo freddo, non trovi?
\bIo non ho freddo. S-s-sei tu che hai freddo.

id: \bBrycen: Welcome to my gym. I have spent many years performing and honing my skills. Do you have what it takes?
en: \bBrycen: Welcome to my gym. I have spent many years performing and honing my skills. Do you have what it takes?
it: \bSilvestro: Benvenuto nella mia palestra. Ho passato molti anni a esibirmi e ad affinare le mie abilità. Hai la stoffa necessaria?

id: \bTM79 contains Frost Breath. It will always score a critical hit.
en: \bTM79 contains Frost Breath. It will always score a critical hit.
it: \bLa MT79 contiene Alitogelido. Va sempre a segno con un brutto colpo.

id: \bBrycen: Come back anytime to train yourself.
en: \bBrycen: Come back anytime to train yourself.

it: \rSilvestro usa solo il tipo Ghiaccio puro.

en: \rBrycen only uses Ice types. No dual types in his team.
it: \rSilvestro usa solo tipi Ghiaccio. Nessun doppio tipo nella sua squadra.

id: \rI keep slipping in this place. It's no fun.
en: \rI keep slipping in this place. It's no fun.
it: \rContinuo a scivolare qui dentro. Non è divertente.

id: \bTraining in extreme tempatures. That raises the spirit.
en: \bTraining in extreme tempatures. That raises the spirit.
it: \bAllenarsi a temperature estreme. Questo tempra lo spirito.

id: \bBrycen uses Ice type Pokémon. They are weak against the Fire, Fighting, Rock, and Steel types.
en: \bBrycen uses Ice type Pokémon. They are weak against the Fire, Fighting, Rock, and Steel types.
it: \bSilvestro usa Pokémon di tipo Ghiaccio. Sono deboli contro i tipi Fuoco, Lotta, Roccia e Acciaio.

id: \bThey are strong against Dragon, Flying, Grass, and Ground. They are resistant to only Ice.
en: \bThey are strong against Dragon, Flying, Grass, and Ground. They are resistant to only Ice.
it: \bSono forti contro Drago, Volante, Erba e Terra. Resistono soltanto al Ghiaccio.

id: \bWhy does every ice gym have to have an ice floor?
en: \bWhy does every ice gym have to have an ice floor?
it: \bPerché ogni palestra di tipo Ghiaccio deve avere il pavimento ghiacciato?
